trade_notes: Counts are Sayari shipment rows grouped by supplier-buyer pair, from Tanzania/China customs. One consignment can appear in more than one row; treat as indicative, not exact consignment counts.
Rule 10 applies: these records show shipper and consignee for HS 261590 leaving Rwanda, not where the ore was mined.

SAYARI_METHOD.md said Boss Mining's coltan buyers spanned TZA, CHN, KOR, JPN, ARE, GBR, NLD. This run (query + hs_code=261590) found only UAE buyers (Novacore FZE, Halcyon). The earlier facet result was probably buyer_country facets across all of a broad query, or other HS codes; the method note should be corrected.

One anomalous row: shipper TRAXYS EUROPE S.A. -> buyer AFRICAN PANTHER RESOURCES LTD, 2024-09-28, departure RWA, arrival CHN, 'TANTALITE ORES AND CONCENTRATES LOT'. Probably shipper/consignee fields swapped in the customs record; not counted above.
Common buyer: HALCYON INC (Dubai) buys from all three exporters (Kanzamin 25, African Panther 7, Boss Mining 1).
